name: Bolt, liquid ice
body:
Source Adventurer's Armory 2 pg. 24
Price 40 gp; Weight —
Category Alchemical Weapons
Description
These metal crossbow bolts have a glass section in the middle filled with liquid iceUE. On a hit, it deals 1d4 points of cold damage in addition to its normal damage. Liquid ice bolts do not cause splash damage.
Construction
Craft (Alchemy) DC 25
